title: Split Torsional Compliance
text: Split torsional coupler, 9 inputs, 10 outputs; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Coupling Configuration} sets the configuration Shaft, {Output Info bus} sets the selection, {Torsional stiffness, k1} sets the stiffness 5e4, {Torsional damping, b1} sets the damping 1e2, {Damping cutoff frequency, omega1_c} sets the frequency, {Torsional stiffness, k2} sets the stiffness 5e4, {Torsional damping, b2} sets the damping 1e2 and {Damping cutoff frequency, omega2_c} sets the frequency. Values come from the instance.
